events.what: Kanigowski and Ravotti prove all locally uniformly shearing (LUS) flows are mixing of all orders, with Kochergin flows on T^2 and smooth time-changes of unipotent flows as corollaries
Ryzhikov survey 'Multiple mixing, 75 years of Rokhlin's problem', stating the general question remains open

judgement.doubts: Agree with the record. The LUS result settles a class of systems (a restriction of the bullet), so it is a case, not whole; the general question stays open per Ryzhikov's survey. Two possibly relevant 2024 preprints (2405.03641, 2404.06476) were not opened by the researcher, and one of them is year-mid-2024 so it would be post-snapshot anyway; unlikely to change the tier.
